WITH at_risk_users AS (
    SELECT 
        userregistry, 
        nicklabel, 
        regmoment, 
        tierstep, 
        ptsval, 
        statustag, 
        personal_attributes
    FROM 
        fans
    WHERE 
        userregistry IN (
            SELECT retainengagepivot
            FROM retentionandinfluence
            WHERE churnflag != 'None'
        )
),
risk_classification AS (
    SELECT 
        aru.userregistry, 
        CASE 
            WHEN r.churnflag = 'Low' THEN 1
            WHEN r.churnflag = 'Medium' THEN 2
            WHEN r.churnflag = 'High' THEN 3
            ELSE 0
        END AS risk_level
    FROM 
        at_risk_users aru
    JOIN 
        retentionandinfluence r ON aru.userregistry = r.retainengagepivot
)
SELECT * INTO at_risk_users_info FROM at_risk_users;

UPDATE retentionandinfluence
SET churnflag = CASE 
    WHEN risk_level = 1 THEN 'Low'
    WHEN risk_level = 2 THEN 'Medium'
    WHEN risk_level = 3 THEN 'High'
    ELSE 'None'
END
FROM risk_classification
WHERE retentionandinfluence.retainengagepivot = risk_classification.userregistry;
